full_judgment: "If fraud is proved then there is no question of limitation. Reliance may be placed in the cases of Abdul Rauf vs Abdul Hamid Khan, 17 DLR (SC) 515 = PLD 1965 (SC) 671 and Saifur Rahman vs Haider Shah, 19 DLR (SC) 433. In view of above discussions, we find merit in this Rule Nisi."
